hero.title: Gear for dogs that work
hero.lead: Nylon and chain collars, sewn in Poland and tested by handlers — before they ever go on sale.
hero.imageAlt: Belgian Malinois shepherd in a red collar

series.heading: A shop for every dog. The Pro section for those that work in service.

shop.title: Dog Store shop
shop.lead: Nylon and chain collars for every dog. Filter by width, neck circumference and colour, shipped within 24 h.

pro.title: Patrol, scent, training
pro.lead: Control handles, module rails, steel hardware. Catalogue and requests for quotation for units.

nonWorking.title: Everyday
nonWorking.lead: Lighter collars for walks and home.

eCollar.title: For e-collars
eCollar.lead: Rails and straps for the module.

manifest.quote: The same stitching and hardware go into a service dog and into a dog heading out for a walk.

params.title: Specs, not slogans
params.body: For every collar we state the webbing width, neck circumference and weight. Strength comes from a test, not from a brochure.

field.title: Field first
field.body: A new model goes to handlers for several months of work. It reaches the shop only once it comes back without a single remark.

repair.title: We repair
repair.body: Torn seams and worn hardware we replace in-house. We don't send you back to the manufacturer, because the manufacturer is us.
